name: Four-Cycle
definition: The cycle on four vertices, equivalently the two-dimensional hypercube $Q_2$ and the Cartesian product $K_2\square K_2$.
properties: It is a two-dimensional hypercube, median graph, maximum class, ample class of rank at most two, daisy cube, and learning-space graph, but it is not a tree. Every proper pc-minor is $K_1$ or $K_2$ and hence a tree.
